original_connection_contract.editor_behavior: The original UI explicitly accounts for the first packet after COM open sometimes being lost. It sends up to five PING commands at700ms each in the SAME open session before rejecting the connection.
original_connection_contract.installer_behavior_documented: M5.32 installer sends a second PING in the same session for the data-toggle case. This is source-supported startup synchronization, not proof that these current failures have that cause.
original_connection_contract.our_previous_singlePING_limit: The single-PING trials test a narrower behavior than the original connect sequence. Their failures do not establish that an original multi-PING session would also fail.

binary_sequence.fact: DTR0 clears connected flagbit1; a0to1 transition invokes endpoint_init0201C480 even when the endpoint-configured flagbit4 was already set.
Reconfigures IN0x82 and OUT0x02, re-registers OUT callback0201C590, then enables endpoint handling.

OUT endpoint configuration writes CSR0x90 through02005D1C; IN configuration writes CSR0x48 through02006AF8. These exact values are established; this audit does not claim a WL82 register-bit mapping from a different USB-controller datasheet.
OUT interrupt calls the registered object+20 callback, which sets globalRXpending byte1C26894 and updates lastUSBactivity atglobal+100.

Control loop skips bulk draining while connected=0. RXpending is cleared only after connected&&RXpending. Thus a DTRfalse PING can leave bytes/pending state undrained until another state transition; this alone is not a demonstrated permanent stall.

The read helper checks endpointRXcount, switches DMA/FIFO pointers, copies bytes and acknowledges endpointCSR. It may return0 with no current RXcount, including after endpoint reconfiguration. A later fresh OUT callback is needed to request another drain.

hypotheses_and_limits.packet_or_toggle_resynchronization: Supported as an original documented first-packet condition and consistent with reconfiguration on DTRrising; not proven as the current root cause without a same-handle multi-PING transcript or bus capture.
hypotheses_and_limits.permanent_CTL_deadlock: Contradicted during the successful BLE diagnostics.
hypotheses_and_limits.DTR_not_received: Contradicted for the observed usb1/usb0 interval; endpoint bulkRX/TX still not proven.
hypotheses_and_limits.next_controlled_observation: Root may separately review a bounded original-style sequence within one DTRtrue open, after requested standard USB unplug/replug if performed by user. No reopen loop, no mutating commands and no firmware change follows from this audit.
